title: Corporate Governance Tech Summit (SF) — Eric opens with fireside on Incorruptible, moderated by Evan Epstein
summary: Pennant AI and the Society for Corporate Governance (Northern California, Hawaii & Nevada Chapter) host the Corporate Governance Tech Summit at WorkOS HQ in San Francisco. Eric opens with a fireside on the governance lessons in Incorruptible, moderated by Evan Epstein (Founder of Boardroom Governance). Every guest takes home a copy of the book. Speaker lineup includes Coinbase, Parnassus Investments, and Cleary Gottlieb Steen & Hamilton. Agenda also covers DExit (Delaware/Texas/Nevada reincorporation), AI in the boardroom, and shareholder activism.
blockquote: Opening fireside with Eric Ries — NYT best-selling author of "The Lean Startup" and founder of the Long-Term Stock Exchange — on the governance lessons in his new book, "Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad and How Great Companies Stay Great". Moderated by Evan Epstein, Founder of Boardroom Governance. Every guest will take home a copy of Eric's new book.
